name: Storefront Experience
charter: Owns the meridian.com web storefront and the My Meridian customer portal, including the shared frontend design system.

name: Search & Discovery
charter: Owns product search, browse and recommendations; relevance quality and index freshness.

name: Cart & Checkout
charter: Owns the cart and the checkout orchestration path from cart to placed order.

name: Catalog
charter: Owns canonical product and offer data and its ingestion from the data platform.

name: Order Management
charter: Owns the order lifecycle and fulfillment orchestration across inventory, warehouse and payments.

name: Pricing
charter: Owns base and regional price resolution and price-consistency guarantees.

name: Promotions & Offers
charter: Owns offers, coupons and cart-level discounts, including promotion-cache correctness.

name: Payments
charter: Owns payment authorization and capture within the PCI cardholder-data boundary.

name: Inventory
charter: Owns real-time available-to-promise inventory and reservation semantics.

name: Core Platform
charter: Owns the API gateway/edge and shared platform capabilities: libraries, API/event contracts, infrastructure and feature flags.
